semiconductor_relevance: Medium — KOFLOC(SHANGHAI) Corp. specializes in fluid measurement and control technologies, which are relevant for gas management in semiconductor processes.
summary: KOFLOC(SHANGHAI) Corp. develops and manufactures precision measuring and control technologies for fluids, including gases critical to semiconductor fabrication. Their products include electronic flow meters and gas generators, which support various applications in the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Electronic flow meters for gas measurement
Fluid control valves for precise gas management

regional_presence.China: KOFLOC(SHANGHAI) Corp. operates in China, focusing on the development and sale of fluid control technologies.
